title: Denim
sub: Wide-leg, straight, barrel and flare jeans plus a denim chore jacket, 30-65% off.

brands.say: Hero: Madison mid rise wide leg in Whimsy, was $118, now $41, 65% off, 9 of 11 sizes in stock. Hero pleated baggy jean in dark wash was $108, now $54, every size in stock. Lowkey low rise flare was $98, now $49.
brands.why_not: All three are tagged final sale. Homepage headline is only 25% off; the 50-65% is on marked-down styles.
